MC-09 (PRIMARY, my call -> M6-OD-012; armed-not-fired): AdsSpendImportDecision.to_public() (models/ads_spend_import.py:68-76) masks actor but exports reason/audit_ref/evidence_ref VERBATIM — reason/audit_ref are CHECKER free-text (human-typed at approval, the likeliest accidental-PII spot besides a payload); a PII-shaped reason would export raw on the durable/export surface. IMPORTANT: the AUDIT TRAIL is already safe — import_gate._audit_decision (import_gate.py:94-103) does NOT echo reason/audit_ref into the audit detail (only import_id + decision enum; subject=actor masked by the sink; boundary MC10 confirmed) — the gap is ONLY the decision object's to_public export. Same durable-export masking-scope family as F-SEC-2K-1 (status) / F-SEC-2M-1 (smoke_id). Reachability: armed-not-fired (no durable-export surface wired — HTTP bind is forward M6-OD-011; actors are internal ops). Fix/route: M6-OD-012 masking scope; cheap defense-in-depth = run reason/audit_ref through the raw-PII tripwire at import (email-shaped reject false-positive-safe) or mask on export -> CODER + M6-OD-012. ACCESS CONTROL (doc §22 line 429 — SUBSTANTIVE this slice; M6.2Q adds the pack's FIRST real authz control): the ads-spend import approval is gated by a maker-checker FOUR-EYES separation of duties (import_gate.record_decision, import_gate.py:57-92). STRUCTURALLY SOUND: an APPROVE is fail-closed refused unless _canon_actor(decision.actor) != _canon_actor(imp.uploaded_by) and the checker is non-blank; distinctness is CANONICALIZED (strip+casefold, a red-team fix over raw ==) so a case/whitespace alias cannot self-approve; only APPROVED materializes; record store set-once; re-decide refused; the API requires all of actor/reason/audit_ref/evidence_ref (OWNER_DECISION_INCOMPLETE otherwise); no network/Marketing-API verb; the system never synthesizes an approval (RULE-015). THE LOAD-BEARING CAVEAT: actor identity is UNAUTHENTICATED free-text — uploaded_by/decision.actor are plain request-body strings, so the gate enforces two DISTINCT STRINGS, not two AUTHENTICATED PRINCIPALS; a single real person can supply maker=A + checker=B and satisfy four-eyes. The control's security value is CONDITIONAL on the forward M6-OD-011 identity binding (HTTP bind + real authN/authZ, out of scope / separate session). The boundary's two four-eyes gaps are instances armed-not-fired until identity is bound: MC9 (a Unicode full-width homoglyph of the maker bypasses casefold -> distinct -> self-approve) and N4 (a blank MAKER + any distinct checker -> APPROVED; the gate refuses a blank checker but not a blank maker). Access-control verdict: the four-eyes shape is correct + fail-closed for the staged posture but is a STRUCTURAL control until M6-OD-011 binds authenticated identity (the honest §22 forward condition, per P0307 SECURITY_PRIVACY_DESIGN §6 the concrete approver identities are an owner decision) -> owner M6-OD-011 for identity binding; CODER for two cheap hardenings that make it robust once identity is bound (NFKC-normalize before casefold in _canon_actor closes MC9; require a non-blank maker closes N4). RULE-003 VERIFIED LOCK HELD: SessionRoasReader._verified (session_roas.py:101-110) filters BOTH the CPA denominator (verified-order count) and the ROAS numerator (verified_revenue) on event_code == ORDER_VERIFIED — a quote/draft in-window contributes 0 (the M6.2L B4 lock carried/mirrored); spend attributed to a session only when its campaign is BOUND (session_for_campaign) and spend_date in the derived window; out-of-window/unbound -> daily_total(); divisions fail-closed via _safe_div (spend+zero-verified -> CPA None/ROAS 0.0; no bound spend -> CPA/ROAS None). Security-positive: the ROAS revenue side cannot count a non-verified row. N1 (F-SEC-2I-1, CARRIED -> owner): asymmetry — session_roas._sessions() groups REVENUE by each event's own live_session_id (_session_key, un-provenanced) while _session_spend authenticates SPEND via the campaign->session binding; so a verified-revenue event on a DIFFERENT campaign tagged with the bound session's live_session_id inflates that session's verified_revenue/ROAS. Standing M6.2I-FUNNEL blocker (single-subject/live_session bind); armed-not-fired (reader internal, no channel export; events from the trusted measurement store); A5 makes it a money number -> owner bind revenue provenance before any real spend/ROAS surface. VALUE-SANITY (N2/RO10 -> CODER; not PII): neither the spend write nor the revenue write checks finiteness/sign — a negative spend/revenue yields negative CPA/ROAS, a NaN revenue makes verified_revenue/ROAS NaN and to_public emits raw NaN (breaks the JSON export contract); spend is maker-checker-approved (trusted) and revenue is Commerce-supplied via a genuine OV row (armed-not-fired); CODER: math.isfinite(v) and v>=0 on both writes (RULE-009-adjacent). HASH POLICY / M6-OD-003: N/A for M6.2Q (spend path sends nothing external; external_send Final OFF, no Marketing API).
